title: Build the assembler
lead: `pit asm bot.s`: turn assembly source into `isa.Cell` values in `internal/asm`, with labels, expressions, and errors that carry line and column; hand-written lexer and parser, Go table-driven tests and a fuzz target.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the disassembler (next slice); running matches.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Goal 2 and acceptance criterion C17: the assembler rejects malformed input with line and column errors.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `docs/spec/asm.md` (new): the assembly syntax, expression operators and precedence, and the `pit asm` output format.
- `internal/asm/lexer.go`, `internal/asm/parser.go`, `internal/asm/expr.go`, `internal/asm/asm.go` (`Assemble(name string, src []byte) ([]isa.Cell, error)` or equivalent).
- `internal/asm/error.go`: an error type carrying file, line, column and message, formatted `file:line:col: message`.
- `internal/asm/asm_test.go`, `internal/asm/expr_test.go`, `internal/asm/fuzz_test.go`.
- `cmd/pit/asm.go`: the `asm` subcommand; `cmd/pit/asm_test.go`.

- `internal/asm/testdata/undefined_label.s` (a malformed program for the CLI check).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestAssemble`: valid programs (inline source strings) assemble to the expected cells, covering every opcode, modifier and addressing mode; checked against `internal/isa`'s lists so a new opcode without a case fails.
- `TestLabels`: forward and backward label references.
- `TestExpr`: expressions evaluate as `docs/spec/asm.md` defines, including precedence and negative values.
- `TestErrors`: each malformed case errors with the exact line and column: unknown opcode, bad addressing mode, undefined label, duplicate label, malformed expression.
- `TestAsmCommand` (`cmd/pit`): source files written under `t.TempDir()`; a valid file exits 0 and prints the documented output; a malformed file exits non-zero and prints `file:line:col: message` on stderr.
- `FuzzAssemble`: arbitrary input never panics; any error is the positioned error type with line and column at least 1.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- PROJECT.md asks for labels and expressions but does not define the syntax, the expression operators, or the `pit asm` output format. The implementer decides them, writes them in `docs/spec/asm.md`, and records each as a catalog decision with a one-line reason (C35); the reviewer checks them.
- Hand-written lexer and parser; no parser dependency (C13).
- Output cells use `isa.Cell`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `. scripts/env.sh && go test ./... && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"` passes.
- `. scripts/env.sh && go test -run '^$' -fuzz FuzzAssemble -fuzztime 60s ./internal/asm` finds no failure.
- `. scripts/env.sh && go run ./cmd/pit asm internal/asm/testdata/undefined_label.s` exits non-zero and prints `internal/asm/testdata/undefined_label.s:LINE:COL: message` with the label's position.
- The reviewer checks each C35 decision recorded by this slice.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-assembler` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
